channel.title: Belgian M31 helmet used by the Civil Defence - Commentaires
channel.description:
The following Belgian M31 helmet was used by the Belgian civil defense. I found information from a real helmet expert. at: http://casquescollection.skyrock.com/3038112889-763-BELGIQUE-Defense-Passive.html
See also: Belgian Beret Korps Burger Bescherming -Corps Protection Civil
Moto: Impavidum ferient ruinae = part of 'Si fractus illabatur orbis impavidum ferient ruinae' and means: 'Should the world break and fall about him, its ruins will strike him unafraid'.
